IncidentBot: INCIDENT: Elevated 5xx rate on hosted inference (service: text-gen). Auto-fallback to model-variant-b triggered. Paging on-call.
Ava (oncall): Acked. I'm checking dashboards now. ETA 5m for triage.
Ava (oncall): Observing a spike in response latency followed by 502s from frontend autoscaler. Looks like a small subset of regions (us-west-2) and a specific model variant.
Diego M.: Any recent deploys in that region? I don't see deploy jobs in the last 30m.
Priya R.: Not from product. I see increased retry traffic from client A (high volume). Could be malformed requests causing KV cache thrash.
Ava (oncall): Running quick query: top error is 'KV_LOAD_FAILED' and 'OOM' on a tiny fraction of pods. Rolling restart of affected nodes in us-west-2 to force cache eviction.
Sam L.: Noted. I've opened TRACK-4821 for live mitigation (restart, observe). Assigning to Ava + infra.
Ava (oncall): Executing rolling restart command now: ``for pod in $(kubectl -n inference get pods -l region=us-west-2 -o name); do kubectl delete $pod; sleep 10; done``
Erin S.: Heads up: customer success flagged a customer seeing degraded QoE. Priya, can you surface impacted customer IDs?
Priya R.: Pulling logs. Primary impacted customers: acct_7642 (high qps), acct_9813 (batch ingest). I put details in TRACK-4821.
Nate H.: I pushed a temporary routing rule to divert 10% of traffic to fallback fleet in eu-west while we stabilize us-west-2. Monitoring for errors.
Ava (oncall): Restarts completed on the 7 affected pods. 5xxs dropped to baseline within 3m. Latency back to normal for most routes.
Maya C.: Confirming client A's errors reduced after restart. They had ~2k failed requests, about 0.4% of global traffic during window.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT UPDATE: degraded -> mitigated. Postmortem suggested; please schedule within 3 business days.
Ava (oncall): I'll hand off to Diego for postmortem. Diego, taking post-incident lead unless you want someone else.
Diego M.: I can take it. Thanks Ava. I'll collect timeline + cause + impact and propose action items.
Priya R.: Initial hypothesis: KV cache pressure from malformed/bursty client patterns causing OOMs on a few pods, cascading to retries and autoscaler thrash.
Sam L.: Also worth noting our alert combined latency+error into a single high priority page. That made it noisy during escalations when only a small % of pods were affected.
Diego M.: Agreed. Proposed postmortem outline: timeline, root cause (KV cache pressure + autoscaler reaction), scope of impact (customer list + SLI hit), remediation taken (restarts, routing), and action items.
Ava (oncall): Handing off: Diego is oncall for timeline consolidation. Priya, Nate, Sam, Maya - please attach logs/graphs to the postmortem doc.
Diego M.: Scheduling: I'll set a postmortem doc and a 60-min follow-up meeting. Prefer slot tomorrow 11:00 PT. If that doesn't work, I'll do an async writeup.
Erin S.: Add Customer Success to the PM. We need a short outbound note if any customers had >1% errors during their critical window.
Priya R.: I've exported request traces and put them in TRACK-4821 and gs://redwood-incident-exports/1758001234/. Also added a short list of impacted tenants.
Sam L.: Action item suggestions (quick list):
- AI-1: Add a dedicated alert for KV_LOAD_FAILED OOM spikes (owner: Priya R., due: 2026-03-22, ticket: INF-1134)
- AI-2: Split paging rules so error-rate pages on per-region/per-pool thresholds rather than global aggregations (owner: Sam L., due: 2026-03-29, ticket: SRE-2209)
- AI-3: Autoscaler cooldown tweak to reduce churn for transient errors (owner: Nate H., due: 2026-03-25, ticket: INF-1135)
- AI-4: Add rate-limiting backpressure patterns for high-QPS tenants at the edge (owner: Diego M., due: 2026-04-05, ticket: PROT-778)
Diego M.: Adding: AI-5: Run chaos test for KV cache eviction behavior under bursty malformed input (owner: Maya C., due: 2026-04-12, ticket: QA-441)
Priya R.: Suggested alert rule snippet for INF-1134:
```
- alert: KVCacheOOMSpike
  expr: sum(rate(kv_cache_load_failures_total[2m])) by (region, pool) > 5
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "KV cache load failures spike in {{ $labels.region }}/{{ $labels.pool }}"
```
Sam L.: Also propose lowering noise by changing the pager flow: only page when both error-rate > X AND affected_pods_ratio > Y OR customer-impacting-tenants > 0. We can implement as composite alert.
Erin S.: For outbound comms, I'll draft a short note for impacted customers. Diego, can you include a one-paragraph root-cause and mitigation summary in the doc?
Diego M.: Yep. I'll include customer impact table + mitigation timeline. Draft in doc by EOD today; meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT for validation.
Ava (oncall): Leaving note: oncall handled restart + temporary routing. No further action required from oncall team, handing back to owners.
IncidentBot: REMINDER: Postmortem doc not created yet. Please create within 72h or incident will auto-escalate to eng leadership.
Diego M.: Created doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/incidents/1758001234-kv-cache-oom. Added initial timeline + attachments. Invited Priya, Sam, Nate, Maya, Erin, Ava.
Priya R.: I've updated INF-1134 with a test alert in staging. Will promote to prod after review.
Nate H.: Tweaked autoscaler cool-down in canary (INF-1135). Observing reduced churn on synthetic load.
Sam L.: I'll lead the SRE change to split paging rule (SRE-2209). Will PR the alert changes by end of week.
Erin S.: Drafted outbound note and posted to the doc's 'customer-comm' section. Diego, feel free to edit.
Diego M.: Thanks all — blockers noted. Action items are tracked (AI-1..AI-5). Will update due dates if scope changes. Meeting tomorrow 11:00 PT. Closing live incident thread.
Maya C.: Copy. I'll add chaos test plan to QA-441 and ping infra for resources.
IncidentBot: INCIDENT: mitigated -> resolved. Auto-close of the paging thread in 1h if no further updates. :white_check_mark:
